info.name: Prafi API
info.description:
Backend API for Prafi (Express + Sequelize + PostgreSQL), with realtime notifications over Socket.IO and emails (nodemailer).

## Setup (once)
1. Import this collection and `Prafi-Local.postman_environment.json`, then select **Prafi Local** (environment dropdown, top right).
2. In **Prafi Local** set `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` (Current value) to the superadmin from `.env` (`SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD`), then Ctrl+S.
3. Start the server (`npm run dev` or `npm run build && npm start`). `baseUrl` is `http://localhost:4000`.
4. Email: set `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_SECURE`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASS`, `MAIL_FROM` in `.env` to send real emails. Set `FRONTEND_URL` to the frontend's address: the forgot-password email links to `<FRONTEND_URL>/reset-password`. Without `SMTP_HOST` (development) emails are printed in the server log and the OTP / activation token is returned in `meta.verification` and saved as `{{otp}}` / `{{verifyToken}}`.

## Login and roles
- Every request uses **Bearer `{{token}}`** (set on the collection; requests inherit it). Public requests have *No Auth*.
- **Auth → Login** saves the token to `{{token}}` (valid **1 hour**). To switch role, change `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` (or the Login body) and send Login again.
- The **name of each request says who can call it**: `(All roles)` = superadmin, disnakertrans, admin and tenant; `(superadmin, disnakertrans, admin)`, `(admin)`, `(tenant)`… = only those roles; `(Public)` = no login. Any other role gets **403**.
- Every account must have a **verified email** (`mailActive: true`) and an **active approval** (`approval.isActive: true`) to log in and use the API.

| role | created by | email verification | approval at start | can |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| superadmin | seed (`npm run db:seed`) | already verified | active | create disnakertrans accounts; **read-only** for everything else (users, products, tenants, tenant categories); notified of every new account and product |
| disnakertrans | superadmin (*Register Disnakertrans*) | activation link (24 h) | active | view and activate/deactivate **admin** accounts, view all products and tenants |
| admin | self sign-up (*Register Admin*) | OTP (15 min) | **inactive** until a disnakertrans activates it | activate tenant accounts **and products**, read users (tenants)/products/tenants, manage tenant categories |
| tenant | self sign-up (*Register Tenant*) | OTP (15 min) | active | manage their own products and tenant profile |

## Endpoints
| folder | endpoint | access |
|---|---|---|
| Health | `GET /api/health` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/login` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/logout` | All roles |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register/disnakertrans` | superadmin |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register/admin` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register/tenant` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/verify-otp/{{userId}}` | Public |
| Auth | `GET /api/auth/verify-email/{{userId}}` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/resend-verification/{{userId}}` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/forgot-password` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/reset-password/check` | Public |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/reset-password` | Public |
| Auth | `GET /api/auth/me` | All roles |
| Auth | `PATCH /api/auth/me` | All roles |
| Images | `POST /api/images` | All roles |
| Images | `GET {{imagePath}}` | Public |
| Images | `DELETE /api/images/{{imageId}}` | tenant |
| Users | `GET /api/users` | superadmin, disnakertrans, admin |
| Approvals | `PATCH /api/approvals/{{userId}}` | disnakertrans, admin |
| Approvals | `PATCH /api/approvals/{{productId}}` | admin |
| Products | `GET /api/products` | All roles |
| Products | `GET /api/products/{{productId}}` | All roles |
| Products | `POST /api/products` | tenant |
| Products | `PATCH /api/products/{{productId}}` | tenant |
| Products | `DELETE /api/products/{{productId}}` | tenant |
| Landing | `GET /api/landing/products` | Public |
| Tenant Categories | `GET /api/tenant-categories` | superadmin, admin |
| Tenant Categories | `GET /api/tenant-categories/{{categoryId}}` | superadmin, admin |
| Tenant Categories | `POST /api/tenant-categories` | admin |
| Tenant Categories | `PATCH /api/tenant-categories/{{categoryId}}` | admin |
| Tenant Categories | `DELETE /api/tenant-categories/{{categoryId}}` | admin |
| Tenants | `GET /api/tenants/me` | tenant |
| Tenants | `POST /api/tenants/me` | tenant |
| Tenants | `PATCH /api/tenants/me` | tenant |
| Tenants | `DELETE /api/tenants/me` | tenant |
| Tenants | `GET /api/tenants` | superadmin, disnakertrans, admin |
| Tenants | `GET /api/tenants/{{tenantProfileId}}` | superadmin, disnakertrans, admin |
| Notifications | `GET /api/notifications` | All roles |
| Notifications | `GET /api/notifications/unread-count` | All roles |
| Notifications | `PATCH /api/notifications/{{notificationId}}/read` | All roles |
| Notifications | `PATCH /api/notifications/read-all` | All roles |
| Notifications | `DELETE /api/notifications/{{notificationId}}` | All roles |
| Examples | `GET /api/admin/ping` | superadmin, admin |
| Examples | `GET /api/tenant/ping` | All roles |
| Realtime (WebSocket) | Socket.IO at `{{baseUrl}}` | All roles (Bearer token) |

## Saved variables
Requests save what the next ones need: `token`, `currentUserId`, `currentRole` (Login) · `userId`, `userRole`, `registeredEmail`, `otp` / `verifyToken` (Register, Resend) · `resetToken` (Forgot Password) · `imageId`, `imagePath` (Upload Image) · `productId` · `categoryId` · `tenantProfileId` · `notificationId`. Each save is printed in the Postman Console.

## Example walkthrough
1. **Login** as superadmin → **Register Disnakertrans** → **Verify Email Link** (or open the link from the email).
2. **Register Admin** → **Verify OTP** (code from the email, or `{{otp}}` in development).
3. Set `loginEmail` = the disnakertrans email, `loginPassword` = `{{newUserPassword}}` → **Login** → **Activate / Deactivate User** with `userId` = the admin's id and `userRole` = `admin`.
4. **Login** as the admin → **Create Tenant Category**.
5. **Register Tenant** → **Verify OTP** → **Login** as the tenant → **Upload Image** → **Create My Tenant** → **Upload Image** again → **Create Product**.
6. **Login** as the admin → **List Notifications** → **Activate / Deactivate Product** → **Landing Products** shows it.

## Responses
- Success: `{ "success": true, "data": …, "meta"?: { page, limit, total, totalPages } | { verification } }`
- Error: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`
- `message` and `details[].message` are in **Bahasa Indonesia** (ready to show in the frontend). `code` and `field` stay in English; frontend logic should switch on `code`.

| status | code (examples) | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `BAD_REQUEST`, `ID_NOT_PROVIDED` | invalid input (`details` lists the fields) |
| 400 | `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED`, `LINK_INVALID`, `LINK_EXPIRED`, `RESET_LINK_INVALID`, `RESET_LINK_EXPIRED` | wrong or expired verification code / link / password reset link |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | no/invalid/expired/logged-out token, or the password was reset → log in again |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN`, `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`, `USER_NOT_ACTIVATED` | wrong role, email not verified yet, or account not activated |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | not found, or not yours |
| 409 | `UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT`, `STILL_IN_USE`, `CONFLICT`, `EMAIL_ALREADY_VERIFIED` | duplicate value, record still in use, already verified |
| 413 | `FILE_TOO_LARGE` | image over 5 MB |
| 429 | `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` | a new verification code was requested less than 60 seconds ago |

## Notifications and realtime
Every role gets notifications for the events that concern them (see **Notifications**); activation notifications include the `approval` with `userId` and the `user`. They arrive live over Socket.IO as `notification:new` (see **Realtime (WebSocket)** for connecting in Postman and in the frontend).

exec: var save = (key, value) => { pm.environment.set(key, value); console.log('saved {{' + key + '}} = ' + value); };
try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* not JSON, e.g. an image */ }
if (body) pm.test('Response has a success flag', () => pm.expect(body).to.have.property('success'));
// Login: keep the token as {{token}} for every other request
// Explain auth failures in the Console
console.warn(pm.info.requestName + ' → ' + pm.response.code + ' ' + body.error.code + ': ' + body.error.message + (role ? ' (logged in as ' + role + ')' : ' (not logged in: send Auth → Login)'));

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

Returns `{ status: "ok" }` when the API is running.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Login, logout, registration, email verification, forgot password and your own account (`/api/auth`).

**Login** saves the token to `{{token}}`, which every other request uses. To act as another role, change `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` (or the body) and send Login again.

| account | registered by | email verification | approval (`isActive`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| disnakertrans | superadmin (*Register Disnakertrans*) | activation **link** in the email (valid 24 h) | active right away |
| admin | themselves (*Register Admin*, public) | 6-digit **OTP** in the email (valid 15 min) | **inactive** until a disnakertrans activates it |
| tenant | themselves (*Register Tenant*, public) | 6-digit **OTP** in the email (valid 15 min) | active right away |

Every new account starts with `mailActive: false`: login and every endpoint that needs a token answer **403 `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`** until the email is verified. Emails are in Bahasa Indonesia.

**Development:** without `SMTP_HOST` in `.env`, emails are not sent but printed in the server log, and the register/resend responses include `meta.verification.devCode` / `devLink`, which the requests save as `{{otp}}` / `{{verifyToken}}`.

**Forgot password:** *Forgot Password* emails a link to the frontend page `<FRONTEND_URL>/reset-password?userId=…&token=…` (valid 30 minutes, single use). That page calls *Check Reset Link*, then *Reset Password* with the new password. A reset ends every existing session.

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

Logs in and saves the access token as `{{token}}` (valid for 1 hour), plus `{{currentUserId}}` and `{{currentRole}}`.

- superadmin: the seed account (`SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` in `.env`)
- disnakertrans / admin / tenant: an account made with the Register requests (password `{{newUserPassword}}`; the email is saved as `{{registeredEmail}}`)

Errors: 401 wrong email/password, 403 `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (verify the email first; `details` has `userId` and `method`), 403 `USER_NOT_ACTIVATED` (account not activated yet). Forgot the password? Use *Forgot Password*.

exec: // Email not verified yet: keep the userId so Verify OTP / Resend Verification can be sent next

if (res.error && res.error.code === 'EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED' && res.error.details) { pm.environment.set('userId', res.error.details.userId); console.log('saved {{userId}} = ' + res.error.details.userId + ' (verify the email: ' + res.error.details.method + ')'); }

request.description:
**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, disnakertrans, admin, tenant)

Revokes the token used for this request (other sessions stay logged in) and clears `{{token}}`. Its open WebSocket connections receive `session:ended` (`logged_out`).

**Access:** superadmin

Creates a **disnakertrans** account (the approver of admin accounts). Its approval is active right away (`approval.isActive: true`), but the email must be activated first: an email in Bahasa Indonesia tells the person the account was created and contains the public activation link (*Verify Email Link*, valid 24 hours). The password is the one in the body; give it to the person yourself.

Notifies every superadmin (`USER_REGISTERED`). Saves `{{userId}}`, `{{userRole}}`, `{{registeredEmail}}` and, in development, `{{verifyToken}}`.

exec: if (v && v.devCode) { pm.environment.set('otp', v.devCode); console.log('saved {{otp}} = ' + pm.environment.get('otp')); }
if (v && v.devLink) { pm.environment.set('verifyToken', v.devLink.split('token=')[1]); console.log('saved {{verifyToken}} = ' + pm.environment.get('verifyToken')); }
if (v && !v.devCode && !v.devLink) console.log('Verification emailed to ' + v.sentTo + ': put the OTP from the email in {{otp}} (or open the link in the email)');

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

Public sign-up for **admin** accounts, no token needed. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the email (valid 15 minutes); verify it with *Verify OTP*. Even after that, the admin cannot log in until a disnakertrans activates it (*Approvals → Activate / Deactivate User*, `approval.isActive: false` until then).

Notifies every disnakertrans (`ADMIN_PENDING_ACTIVATION`) and superadmin (`USER_REGISTERED`). Saves `{{userId}}`, `{{userRole}}`, `{{registeredEmail}}` and, in development, `{{otp}}`.

Response: `data` = the new user (`mailActive: false`), `meta.verification` = `{ method: "otp", sentTo, expiresAt, emailSent }`.

exec: if (v && v.devCode) { pm.environment.set('otp', v.devCode); console.log('saved {{otp}} = ' + pm.environment.get('otp')); }
if (v && v.devLink) { pm.environment.set('verifyToken', v.devLink.split('token=')[1]); console.log('saved {{verifyToken}} = ' + pm.environment.get('verifyToken')); }
if (v && !v.devCode && !v.devLink) console.log('Verification emailed to ' + v.sentTo + ': put the OTP from the email in {{otp}} (or open the link in the email)');

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

Public sign-up, no token needed. `tenantName` is required. The tenant is **active right away** once the email is verified: a 6-digit OTP is sent to the email (valid 15 minutes), verify it with *Verify OTP*.

Notifies every admin (`TENANT_REGISTERED`) and superadmin (`USER_REGISTERED`). Saves `{{userId}}`, `{{userRole}}`, `{{registeredEmail}}` and, in development, `{{otp}}`.

exec: if (v && v.devCode) { pm.environment.set('otp', v.devCode); console.log('saved {{otp}} = ' + pm.environment.get('otp')); }
if (v && v.devLink) { pm.environment.set('verifyToken', v.devLink.split('token=')[1]); console.log('saved {{verifyToken}} = ' + pm.environment.get('verifyToken')); }
if (v && !v.devCode && !v.devLink) console.log('Verification emailed to ' + v.sentTo + ': put the OTP from the email in {{otp}} (or open the link in the email)');

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

Admin and tenant accounts: confirms the email with the 6-digit code from the registration email. `:userId` is the id returned by the registration (or by a 403 `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` login error). Body: `{ "otp": "123456" }` (`OTP` is accepted too). On success `mailActive` becomes `true` and the user can log in.

Errors: 400 `OTP_INVALID` (wrong code, `details.attemptsLeft`; after 5 wrong tries a new code is needed), 400 `OTP_EXPIRED` (older than 15 minutes), 409 `EMAIL_ALREADY_VERIFIED`, 404 unknown user.

**Access:** public, no token

Disnakertrans accounts: the activation link from the email. Opened in a browser it shows a confirmation page (Bahasa Indonesia); API clients get JSON. On success `mailActive` becomes `true`.

Errors: 400 `LINK_INVALID`, 400 `LINK_EXPIRED` (older than 24 hours), 409 `EMAIL_ALREADY_VERIFIED`.

**Access:** public, no token

Sends a new OTP (admin, tenant) or activation link (disnakertrans); the previous one stops working. At most once per 60 seconds (429 `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`, `details.retryAfterSeconds`). Saves the new `{{otp}}` / `{{verifyToken}}` in development.

exec: if (v && v.devCode) { pm.environment.set('otp', v.devCode); console.log('saved {{otp}} = ' + pm.environment.get('otp')); }
if (v && v.devLink) { pm.environment.set('verifyToken', v.devLink.split('token=')[1]); console.log('saved {{verifyToken}} = ' + pm.environment.get('verifyToken')); }
if (v && !v.devCode && !v.devLink) console.log('Verification emailed to ' + v.sentTo + ': put the OTP from the email in {{otp}} (or open the link in the email)');

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

Emails a link to reset the password (Bahasa Indonesia), valid **30 minutes**, single use. The link opens the **frontend** page `<FRONTEND_URL>/reset-password?userId=…&token=…` (`FRONTEND_URL` in `.env`), which calls *Check Reset Link* and *Reset Password*.

The answer is always the same 200 message, whether or not the email has an account, so it can't be used to find registered emails. At most one email per account every 60 seconds (extra requests get the same answer but send nothing).

**Development:** without `SMTP_HOST` the email is printed in the server log and `meta.devLink` is returned; this request saves its `userId` / `token` as `{{userId}}` / `{{resetToken}}`.

exec: if (link) { var q = {}; link.split('?')[1].split('&').forEach((p) => { var kv = p.split('='); q[kv[0]] = decodeURIComponent(kv[1]); }); pm.environment.set('userId', q.userId); console.log('saved {{userId}} = ' + pm.environment.get('userId')); pm.environment.set('resetToken', q.token); console.log('saved {{resetToken}} = ' + pm.environment.get('resetToken')); }
else console.log('Reset link emailed (if the account exists): copy userId and token from the link into {{userId}} / {{resetToken}}');

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

For the frontend's reset page: is the link from the email still usable? Answers `{ valid: true, email: "a*****i@gmail.com", expiresAt }` (masked email, to show whose password is being reset).

Errors: 400 `RESET_LINK_INVALID` (wrong, used or replaced by a newer link), 400 `RESET_LINK_EXPIRED` (older than 30 minutes).

**Access:** public, no token

Sets the new password (at least 8 characters). The link can only be used once. Because the link came by email, the email also counts as verified (`mailActive: true`).

**Logs the account out everywhere:** every token issued before the reset answers 401, and open WebSocket connections get `session:ended` with reason `password_reset`. Log in again with the new password.

Errors: 400 validation (`password` under 8 characters), 400 `RESET_LINK_INVALID`, 400 `RESET_LINK_EXPIRED`.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.environment.unset('token'); console.log('Password changed: {{token}} cleared, log in again with the new password'); }

request.description:
**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, disnakertrans, admin, tenant)

The logged-in account with its `faceImage`, account `approval` and `mailActive`.

**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, disnakertrans, admin, tenant)

Updates your own account; send only the fields to change: `firstName`, `lastName`, `phoneNumber`, `email`, `faceImageId` (or `null`), `tenantName` (tenants only), `password` + `currentPassword`.

`id`, `role` and `mailActive` can never be changed here. Replacing `faceImageId` (or setting it to `null`) deletes the old image and its file.

item.name: Images
item.description: Image upload (max 5 MB; jpg, png, webp, gif). Upload first, then use the returned id as `faceImageId`, product `imageId` or tenant `logoId`. Files are served publicly at `imgUrl`. When a record's image is replaced, the old image and its file are deleted automatically.

request.description:
**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, disnakertrans, admin, tenant)

multipart/form-data, field **image** (pick a file in Body → form-data). Saves `{{imageId}}` and `{{imagePath}}` (`imgUrl`; the response also has the full link in `url`).

An image can be used once: as one product image, one tenant logo or one face image.

**Access:** public, no token

The public link of the uploaded image (`{{baseUrl}}` + `imgUrl`), as the frontend would load it.

**Access:** tenant

Deletes the image record and file. An image still used as a tenant logo cannot be deleted (409 `STILL_IN_USE`).

item.name: Users
item.description: Account lists. superadmin sees every account, disnakertrans sees admin accounts, admin sees tenant accounts. Tenants only have *Auth → Me*.

request.description:
**Access:** superadmin, disnakertrans, admin

superadmin: every account; disnakertrans: admin accounts only; admin: tenant accounts only. Optional `role` filter. Each user includes `faceImage`, `approval` and `mailActive`.

item.name: Approvals
item.description:
Activate / deactivate accounts and products: `PATCH /api/approvals/:id?type=user|product`. `:id` is the **user id** or **product id** (not the approval id).

| type | who can | what |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | disnakertrans → admin accounts; admin → tenant accounts | an inactive account cannot log in, and is disconnected from realtime right away |
| `product` | admin only | active products appear on the landing page |

The superadmin is **read-only** and cannot activate anything (disnakertrans accounts it creates are active right away). Every deactivation of an account notifies the superadmins (`USER_DEACTIVATED`).

Every approval has a `type` (`user` = account approval, `product` = product approval) and a `userId` (the account, or the tenant who owns the product).

request.description:
**Access:** disnakertrans, admin

`isActive`: true/false. `role`: the target account's role, as a confirmation (must match). `reason`: optional.

disnakertrans activates/deactivates **admin** accounts; admin activates/deactivates **tenant** accounts. Uses `{{userId}}` / `{{userRole}}` saved by the Register requests. Deactivating ends the user's sessions (`session:ended`, reason `deactivated`) and notifies superadmins.

**Access:** admin

Approves a product (shown on the landing page) or takes it down. The owner gets `PRODUCT_APPROVED`; admins get `PRODUCT_PUBLISHED`; deactivation notifies superadmins.

The response includes who owns it:
```json
{ "type": "product", "id": "…", "name": "…", "approval": { "type": "product", "userId": "…", "isActive": true, … },
  "user": { "firstName": "Budi", "lastName": "Santoso", …, "tenant": { … } | null, "productId": "…", "product": { … } } }
```

item.name: Products
item.description: Tenants manage their own products; superadmin, disnakertrans and admin read all of them. New products start **inactive** and wait for an admin (*Approvals → Activate / Deactivate Product*).

request.description:
**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, disnakertrans, admin, tenant)

superadmin/disnakertrans/admin: every product. tenant: only their own. Optional `isActive` filter (e.g. `false` = waiting for approval).

**Access:** any logged-in role (superadmin, disnakertrans, admin, tenant)

Tenants get 404 for products that are not theirs.

**Access:** tenant

Upload the image first (*Images → Upload Image*); `imageId` is required. Saves `{{productId}}`. Superadmins and admins get `PRODUCT_SUBMITTED`, the tenant gets `PRODUCT_UNDER_REVIEW`.

**Access:** tenant

Own products only. Send any of `name`, `description`, `details`, `qty`, `imageId`. Activation cannot be changed here. Replacing `imageId` deletes the old image and its file.

**Access:** tenant

Own products only. Also deletes its approval and image.

**Access:** public, no token

Active (approved) products only, without private data (no owner email/phone, no approval reason).

item.name: Tenant Categories
item.description: Categories a tenant profile belongs to (e.g. Kuliner, Fashion). Managed by admin; the superadmin can read them (read-only).

request.description:
**Access:** superadmin, admin

Sorted by name.
**Access:** superadmin, admin

**Access:** admin

Names are unique. Saves `{{categoryId}}`.
**Access:** admin

**Access:** admin

A category still used by a tenant profile cannot be deleted (409 `STILL_IN_USE`).

item.name: Tenants
item.description: Tenant (shop) profiles. A tenant user manages **their own** profile at `/api/tenants/me`; superadmin, disnakertrans and admin read every profile.

request.description:
**Access:** tenant

404 if you have not created your profile yet.

**Access:** tenant

One profile per tenant. Required: every field except `name` (defaults to your tenantName). `logoId`: upload the logo first. `categoryId`: a tenant category (created by an admin). Saves `{{tenantProfileId}}`.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Warung Budi",
  "description": "Kopi dan makanan ringan",
  "address": "Jl. Merdeka No. 1",
  "area": "Bandung",
  "operationalHours": "08:00 - 22:00",
  "fbLink": "https://facebook.com/warungbudi",
  "whatsappLink": "https://wa.me/6281298765432",
  "gmapsLink": "https://maps.app.goo.gl/example",
  "logoId": {{imageId}},
  "categoryId": {{categoryId}}
}

exec: ['imageId', 'categoryId'].forEach((k) => { if (!pm.environment.get(k)) throw new Error('{{' + k + '}} is empty: ' + (k === 'imageId' ? 'upload the logo first (Images → Upload Image)' : 'create a category first as superadmin/admin (Tenant Categories → Create)')); });

request.description:
**Access:** tenant

Send only the fields to change. Admins get `TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATED`. Replacing `logoId` deletes the old logo and its file.

**Access:** tenant

Deletes your tenant profile (your account stays).

**Access:** superadmin, disnakertrans, admin

Every tenant profile with its owner, logo and category. Optional `categoryId` filter.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200 && pm.response.json().data.length) { pm.environment.set('tenantProfileId', pm.response.json().data[0].id); console.log('saved {{tenantProfileId}} = ' + pm.environment.get('tenantProfileId')); }

request.description: **Access:** superadmin, disnakertrans, admin

item.name: Notifications
item.description:
Notifications for every role (`/api/notifications`, Bearer `{{token}}`). They are created automatically by actions in the other folders.

| type | who gets it | when |
|---|---|---|
| `USER_REGISTERED` | superadmin | any new account (disnakertrans, admin, tenant) |
| `ADMIN_PENDING_ACTIVATION` | disnakertrans | a new admin signed up (needs activation) |
| `PRODUCT_SUBMITTED` | superadmin, admin | a tenant creates a product |
| `USER_DEACTIVATED` | superadmin | a disnakertrans or admin deactivates a user account |
| `PRODUCT_DEACTIVATED` | superadmin | an admin deactivates a product |
| `PRODUCT_PUBLISHED` | admin | an admin activates a product (now on the landing page) |
| `PRODUCT_UPDATED` | admin | a tenant updates a product |
| `TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATED` | admin | a tenant updates their tenant profile |
| `TENANT_REGISTERED` | admin | a new tenant signs up |
| `PRODUCT_UNDER_REVIEW` | tenant (owner) | they create a product |
| `PRODUCT_APPROVED` | tenant (owner) | their product is activated |

Each notification: `id`, `type` (switch on it in the frontend), `name` (title), `description` (message), `entityType` + `entityId` (what to open: `user`, `product` or `tenant`), `approvalId` + `approval`, `isRead`, `readAt`, `createdAt`.

**Activation notifications** (`USER_REGISTERED`, `ADMIN_PENDING_ACTIVATION`, `TENANT_REGISTERED`, `PRODUCT_SUBMITTED`, `PRODUCT_UNDER_REVIEW`, `PRODUCT_PUBLISHED`, `PRODUCT_APPROVED`, `PRODUCT_DEACTIVATED`, `USER_DEACTIVATED`) include the approval of the user/product they are about:
```json
"approval": { "id": 137, "type": "user", "userId": "<id>", "isActive": false, "reason": "Waiting for activation by disnakertrans", "updatedAt": "...",
  "user": { "id": "<id>", "firstName": "Andi", "lastName": "Wijaya", "email": "...", "phoneNumber": "...", "role": "admin", "tenantName": null, ... } }
```
`approval.isActive` is the **current** status (not a copy from when it was sent), so the frontend can show an *Activate* button only while it is still `false`. To activate: `PATCH /api/approvals/{entityId}?type={entityType}` (body `{ "isActive": true, "role": "admin" }` for users, `{ "isActive": true }` for products). Other notifications (`PRODUCT_UPDATED`, `TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATED`) have `approvalId: null`, `approval: null`. If the product is deleted, `approval` becomes `null`. Every user only ever sees their own notifications (others → 404).

Endpoints: `GET /api/notifications?page=&limit=&unread=true` (newest first, `meta.unreadCount` for the badge), `GET /api/notifications/unread-count`, `PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read`, `PATCH /api/notifications/read-all`, `DELETE /api/notifications/:id`. `approval.user` is whose approval it is (the account owner, or the tenant who owns the product); it never contains the password.
